programme.title: File Eredivisie
programme.desc: The fifth episode focuses on the free kick. A successful free kick is the ultimate proof that your feet can do what your head wants. At the beginning of this century there were regularly more than forty hits per season, but in recent years the number has not even exceeded fifteen. programme.title: River Monsters 3 – Jungle Assassin | S03E07
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy visits Suriname to track down the dangerous striped toothed toothfish, commonly called anjumara by the locals. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – Ocean Wanderer | S01E02
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks have lived on Earth since before the age of dinosaurs - they have been roaming the oceans for over 400 million years. Only today are scientists beginning to discover the secrets of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Big cats in a small world – Flood | E02
programme.desc: The life of the big cats living in the Gomoti River in Botswana is not an easy one. They have to deal with floods as well as intruders. Surviving in this demanding environment forces leopards, lions and cheetahs to use all their skills. The Moelo herd is very exhausted. Faced with winter flooding, young cheetahs must make a difficult decision. Sephiri must choose between her family and her young ones. Canada. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – In a Hurry | E04
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – It's a trap! | E05
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Dry savanna | E01
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Lions' prey tend to feed when the hunters are resting - the hottest time of the day. The increase in temperature affects the behavior of animals living in these hot areas. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: The majesty, complexity and ecological connections of our planet will be presented. You can only see them all from a bird's eye view... Great Britain. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Australia: to save animals – Patsy the echidna | E08
programme.desc: Dr Bree and her team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital rescue Australian animals in need of help. They treat a variety of creatures, from tiny echidnas to koalas and kangaroos. Patsy the echidna has a broken beak. Therefore, it is undergoing review. Meanwhile, Olly the pelican has a huge tear in the skin pouch under his beak. The bird will not survive unless it receives proper help. Little jamraj Crash lost his mother. Australia. 2021. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Titanic on the Amazon | S06E01
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets out in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits various parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Several hundred passengers died in the disaster of the Sobral Santos ship on the Amazon River. Many people were eaten alive after being in the water. Jeremy takes a closer look at the tragic events and explains what happened. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons: Spring (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, Kanada, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «America's Wild Seasons»…Across the continent, the land and its wildlife breathe in warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. For others, it's the time to tend to brand new life | The wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary series | Director: Jeff Morales | Cast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: Africa's Hunters: Bound by Blood (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep3 «Africa's Hunters»…Dry season in Zambia means new life for the Nsefu pride of lions along the Luangwa River. From their first day on earth to the playful days of youth, see how new cubs rely on the strong bond of the entire pride for their survival | Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters | Director: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Land of Primates: The Geladas of Ethiopia (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «Land of Primates»…Geladas are only found among the peaks and plateaus of Ethiopias Simien Mountains, an ancient range of incredible beauty and biodiversity. We follow the Mountain Band of Geladas as they make their daily migration from the cliff edge to the mountaintop | This fascinating documentary series takes a close look at some of our closest relatives in the animal kingdom: the primates. Explore the characteristics, lifestyles and personalities of these resilient creatures as they face daily challenges in their quest for survival. The film crew visist Madagascar, home to several species of lemur, some found nowhere else on the planet, and we examine how they have adapted to the habitat of this unique island. In the heart of South Africa, an alpha male baboon has to protect his family from a dangerous rival gang. The Semien region of Ethiopia is home to geladas, mountain primates who overcome the difficulties of their rocky home. In Zanzibar, the colobus monkey face the threat of being hunted to extinction | Director: Claudio Velazques-Rojas, Jordan-Laine Calder

Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. programme.title: Land of Primates: The Geladas of Ethiopia (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep5 «Land of Primates»…Geladas are only found among the peaks and plateaus of Ethiopias Simien Mountains, an ancient range of incredible beauty and biodiversity. We follow the Mountain Band of Geladas as they make their daily migration from the cliff edge to the mountaintop | This fascinating documentary series takes a close look at some of our closest relatives in the animal kingdom: the primates. Explore the characteristics, lifestyles and personalities of these resilient creatures as they face daily challenges in their quest for survival. The film crew visist Madagascar, home to several species of lemur, some found nowhere else on the planet, and we examine how they have adapted to the habitat of this unique island. In the heart of South Africa, an alpha male baboon has to protect his family from a dangerous rival gang. The Semien region of Ethiopia is home to geladas, mountain primates who overcome the difficulties of their rocky home. In Zanzibar, the colobus monkey face the threat of being hunted to extinction | Director: Claudio Velazques-Rojas, Jordan-Laine Calder

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của Bác Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ĐỈNH MÙ SƯƠNG - THE FOGGY MOUNTAIN
programme.desc: Phi, một võ sĩ kỳ cựu, lên đường tìm cách trả thù sau khi tên trùm tội phạm tàn nhẫn Ba Râu giết vợ mình. Cuộc hành trình đưa anh đến ngôi làng hẻo lánh gần Núi Sương, nơi anh phát hiện ra các hoạt động buôn người của Ba Râu. Cuộc đọ sức cuối cùng là không thể tránh khỏi khi Phi phải hạ gục Ba Râu để cứu dân làng và trả thù cho cái chết của vợ mình.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK

Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần.
